description: A test script for 'git send-pack' that sets up a remote repository, creates references, and verifies push behavior using various input methods, including inline references and stdin.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates a new Git reference with the provided name and commit.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Removes the remote.git directory and reinitializes it as a bare repository.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that a specific reference has been correctly pushed to the remote repository.
